decisions.subject: Narration TTS engine

options_considered.label: Chatterbox (Kaggle T4, runtime=KAGGLE_GPU)
options_considered.reason: Near-real-time on T4 (RTF 1.08 avg across 270 scenes). Preferred by ear in 10-scene compare. Single built-in default voice; cloning available for channel timbres later. Shorter durations than Kokoro (~14.5% total runtime reduction).

options_considered.label: Kokoro-82M (local CPU, runtime=LOCAL)
options_considered.reason: Was the prior sole engine. Retained as documented manual fallback only (Kaggle GPU quota exhaustion / HF Hub rate-limit on Chatterbox download). Not the default.
options_considered.rejected_because: Reversed 2026-07-11: Chatterbox now runs near-real-time on the Kaggle T4 runtime already in the pipeline, and was preferred by ear. Kokoro demoted to manual fallback, not deleted.

decisions.reason: Reversal of the prior 'Kokoro sole TTS' decision. New evidence: Kaggle T4 RTF verified ~1.08 (near-real-time), 10-scene by-ear preference for Chatterbox, and consistently shorter durations. See docs/decisions/tts-engine-chatterbox-reversal.md.
